_note: Batch 23 — four more PlanForge Tier-A tools plus composition_motif_bind_edit's TENTH arm. All four take a real `run_id`, seeded free and deterministically through plan_propose_spec mode='rules' (whose resulting status DEPENDS ON THE DOCUMENT: a two-arc source compiles, a one-arc source stays 'proposed' — which is why the seeds now assert only that a run EXISTS). Two of the four have a SECOND precondition beyond the run and are expected to say so: plan_link wants a COMPILED plan; plan_keep_material wants verbatim quotes the author kept from plan_find_missing_material, which has not been run here. A refusal naming the missing thing is the correct outcome for both, and the falsifiers say so up front.

scenarios.prompt: Understand my note about the plan — the second arc drags, give the Drowned Court more weight.
scenarios.prompt_source: meta.synonyms['understand my note'] + ['plan feedback'], verbatim, followed by a real piece of free-text feedback because that is exactly what the tool's `user_message` argument is for.

seed_assert.query: SELECT count(*)::text FROM plan_run WHERE book_id='{book_id}'
seed_assert.why: ONE real run, and the source names TWO arcs so 'the second arc' in the prompt resolves to something real. This tool turns free text into a structured FeedbackInterpretation, so the interesting question is whether the interpretation points at the arc the author actually named. 🔴 STATUS DROPPED FROM THE ASSERTION, and the reason is worth keeping: mode='rules' lands the run at 'compiled' when the document has enough structure to compile (two arcs) and at 'proposed' when it does not (one arc). I asserted 'compiled' first (cost 5 runs), then 'corrected' to 'proposed' (cost 5 more) — both were true, for different inputs, and neither was safe to assert. The run EXISTING is what the fixture needs; its status is the tool's business.

scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF: an interpretation is written with NO confirm card (Tier A), OR the model invents a run_id, OR the interpretation's focus points at Arc I when the author said the SECOND arc drags — a feedback tool that mis-targets is worse than one that refuses, because the author's note is then applied to the wrong part of their book.

ship_audit.absent_case: OWED — a run_id that does not exist must be refused.
ship_audit.empty_case: OWED — empty or meaningless feedback must be refused, not interpreted into a confident revision.

# Emberfall

## Arc I — The Emberfall
### Chapter 1 — The Ember Codex
Aldric Vane climbs the black stair.

seed_assert.query: SELECT count(*)::text FROM plan_run WHERE book_id='{book_id}'
seed_assert.why: ONE run. CONTROL STATED UP FRONT: this tool writes lines the author KEPT from plan_find_missing_material, and its description is emphatic — 'using ONLY quotes the au[thor kept]'. No material check has been run here, so there ARE no kept quotes, and the honest outcome is a refusal or a question. The `kept` argument is REQUIRED, so the model must either obtain real quotes or decline.

scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF: material is written with NO confirm card (Tier A), OR — the failure this tool is most exposed to — the model FABRICATES the kept quotes. Its description says to pass only quotes the author actually kept, so inventing plausible lines would write text into the author's plan that they never approved and never wrote. That is worse than any refusal.

ship_audit.absent_case: OWED — a run_id that does not exist must be refused.
ship_audit.empty_case: OWED — an empty `kept` map must be refused rather than written as a no-op.

scenarios.prompt: Bind the motif Emberfall Braid to the first arc of this book.

seed_assert.query: SELECT count(*)::text FROM motif_application WHERE motif_id=(SELECT id FROM motif WHERE code='emberfall-braid-b23-{run_id}')
seed_assert.why: ZERO bindings for THIS motif. TENTH ARM: 48 attempts have produced exactly 1 clean run, and that run called the tool and minted its Tier-A card with the store unchanged — so the tool works and what is missing is K>=3 CLEAN runs. Every other attempt died on the degenerate `<tool_call|>` output after a successful motif_search.

scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF: a binding lands with NO confirm card (Tier A), OR the op chosen is not `bind`, OR the model invents a node_id or motif_id. A run that ends with no prose and no card is D-SILENT-TURN-NO-CARD-NO-PROSE — a MODEL-output defect to be re-run, never read as 0/5.

ship_audit.absent_case: OWED — a node_id or motif_id that does not exist must be refused.
ship_audit.idempotency: OWED — the same binding twice must not create two applications.
ship_audit.tenancy: OWED — the node is book-scoped and the motif ACCOUNT-scoped.

_fixture_note: Plan seeds assert that a run EXISTS, never its status: mode='rules' compiles a two-arc document and leaves a one-arc document proposed. Asserting either cost a full arm.
